channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Igor Kokoskov | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Igor Kokoskov from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Zeljko Obradovic, Igor Kokoskov
item.description:
“I don’t watch a lot of seminars, but I like to look them up. I was watching Obradovic and a couple of other coaches, such as Dusan Alimpijevic, who’s now coaching Besiktas. I watched Igor Kokoskov, who is in Atlanta now. I watched a couple of seminars. If you want to be good, you need to be a fanatic in basketball; that needs to be your life, and I like to see something different; why not?”

Nikola Jokic on Zeljko Obradovic, Igor Kokoskov, Oct 7, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: James Jones on Igor Kokoskov
item.description:
Gina Mizell:James Jones on firing Igor Kokoskov:

“I have a ton of respect for Igor. He's an extraordinary human being. A really good coach. The wins & losses this year weren't the factor that I really focused on. It was just a collective set of issues that I thought we could improve.”

James Jones on Igor Kokoskov, Apr 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: James Jones on Igor Kokoskov
item.description:
Gina Mizell:James Jones on Igor Kokoskov’s firing:

“The decision (on) Igor was mine and mine alone. That’s why it was tough.”

James Jones on Igor Kokoskov, Apr 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Igor Kokoskov
item.description:
“We are thrilled to bring Valley resident Igor Kokoškov back to Arizona as head coach of the Phoenix Suns,”

Ryan McDonough on Igor Kokoskov, May 2, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Igor Kokoskov
item.description:
While Dragic's confidence wavered, Nash, Grant Hill and assistant coaches kept him afloat as he doubted his decision to come to the U.S.

“[Kokoskov] was my second father. When I came to the States, he speaks the same language as I do. He was there for me 24/7,”

Goran Dragic on Igor Kokoskov, Feb 15, 2018. Source: ESPN.
